cohort: 80 pregnant patients presenting to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at KIMS hospital, Bengaluru, India from January 2019 to June 2020 diagnosed with oligohydramnios with intact membranes and an amniotic fluid index (AFI) < 5 cm.
finding: Oligohydramnios was associated with higher rates of induction and Cesarean section and lower birth weight.
mod_finding: 61.2% of participants with oligohydramnios underwent Cesarean section, compared to 38.7% who delivered vaginally.
